payload.leagueSummary: NET is the brawl in this window, and KeithK75 is the one making everyone else look like they showed up with rental clubs. The top of the board is split between guys winning with clean tee-to-green golf (KeithK75, Dan94, MattF) and weird little survival acts where the short game drags a battered tee ball to the cash line (CRANK, tnboles77). Below that, the wheels come off fast: DREADFUL, IUDoc92, and Leroy4522 are handing the field way too many bogeys and doubles, which is a brutal way to volunteer for the bottom half.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the profile of the window: elite approach play, steady scoring, and enough putting to keep the whole operation from turning into a museum exhibit.
Dan94 and MattF are the cleanest gross swingers in the file, but Dan94 is doing it with a massive tee ball while MattF is basically speedrunning chaos with a hot putter and absurd birdie output.

The ugly side is very ugly: DREADFUL and Leroy4522 are buried by poor tee-to-green play, while IUDoc92 is somehow winning net events despite a stat line that looks like it was assembled during a thunderstorm.
